name: hacker-toes-6
description: A private multiplayer chat, voice calling and remote soundboard for macOS and Windows.

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish always
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --publish always
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check internet-server.js && node --check access.js && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron-builder.config.cjs && vite build
